positions.as_written: Ask whether the bindings released, because a binding that did not release transmitted the whole force to the knee.
Ask about the fall: a slow twisting fall, a backward fall onto the tails of the skis, or a high speed fall.
Ask about ability and conditions, since a beginner falling slowly and an expert falling fast produce different injuries.
Ask whether they could ski down or needed to be taken off the mountain.
Ask about swelling timing as always.
The timing of the ski season is a legitimate factor in elective planning and should be named as a preference rather than disguised as a clinical reason.
